facts.text: The opera was premiered on 13 March 1797 at the Théâtre Feydeau, Paris.
facts.evidence: The opera was premiered on 13 March 1797 at the Théâtre Feydeau, Paris.

facts.text: The libretto by François-Benoît Hoffman (Nicolas Étienne Framéry) was based on Euripides' tragedy of Medea and Pierre Corneille's play Médée.
